name: RSI oversold snapback (5m)
rationale: A low 5m RSI in a non-trending regime (ADX below a ceiling) flags short-term overextension that snaps back as the selling impulse exhausts and liquidity providers reload. The other side is the momentum-chasing seller who arrives late to a move that has already spent itself. Edge persists because 5m crypto flow is dominated by reactive retail and stop cascades that overshoot. Distinct from band z-score reversion: RSI measures momentum overextension, not distance from a mean. Disconfirmer: exits when RSI recovers above the exit level, or the stop fires if the drop was the front of a trend the ADX gate failed to catch.
catalyst: momentum exhaustion in a non-trending intraday tape
